crop.notes: Whole right-hand column of ads (dry goods, amusements, proposals, Kearney's Extract Buchu); Allen appears only in the Deagle's Theatre amusement ad.

ocr.notes: Deagle's ad readable: 'Tuesday, Oct. 28, benefit to TOM ALLEN, Champion of America.'

title.suggested: Deagle's Theatre Advertises Benefit for Tom Allen

summary.suggested: A Deagle's Theatre advertisement in the Missouri Republican listed a benefit on Tuesday, October 28, for Tom Allen, "Champion of America," during Miss Anna Hathaway's engagement.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, Wednesday, October 29, 1873', page 5. Not yet the St. Louis Republic.

facts.fact: Deagle's Theatre advertised a benefit for Allen, billed as Champion of America, on Tuesday, October 28, 1873
places: Deagle's Theatre, Sixth above Locust Street, St. Louis

notes: The ad ran the day after the benefit date. Same page as 493.
